The '''''Compass Star''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that took part in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. During the course of the battle it was sent to the aid of the ''[[Loyal Defender]]'', which had been so heavily damaged that an evacuation order had been issued.<ref name="Revelation" />
